note: Recast from the original English description of Bose 1999 (new species; type locality natural forest at Ganga Lake, Itanagar, Arunachal Pradesh, India; named for Shamim Jairajpuri, former Director of the Zoological Survey of India). The material is only 2 soldiers and 5 workers; the alate is unknown. Measurements are translated word for word from the original, in millimetres, with the holotype value in parentheses.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The soldier differs from the other Indian species, P. khasii khasii, in its much smaller size: head length (to the mandibular base) 0.95—0.98 mm and head width 0.85 mm, against 1.26 mm and 1.08 mm in the latter; mandibles shorter, 0.63 mm, against 0.65—0.75 mm; pronotum much smaller, width 0.50—0.53 and length 0.28 mm, against 0.65—0.72 mm and 0.34—0.47 mm respectively. Only 2 species of the genus occur in northeastern India and the alates of both are unknown; the key separates them by body size (head length to mandibular base 1.26, head width 1.08, pronotum width 0.72 in P. khasii khasii; head length to mandibular base 0.95—0.98, head width 0.85, pronotum width 0.50—0.53 in this species).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow, the frontal region whitish; mandibles brownish, brownish yellow at the base; antennae, thorax, legs and abdomen pale milky white. Head and body sparsely hairy. Total body length 3.0—3.3 mm (holotype 3.25). Head capsule suboblong-oval, longer than wide; sides weakly convergent anteriorly; posterior corners rounded, posterior margin convex. Fontanelle small, median, with a groove from the fontanelle to the apex of the labrum; frontal gland as figured. Compound eyes and ocelli absent. Antenna 12 segments, hairy: segment 1 long, cylindrical; segment 2 short, about half of segment 1, cylindrical; segment 3 longer than segment 2, club-shaped; segments 4 and 5 globose, nearly equal in length, the shortest; the remaining segments nearly equal, globose; terminal segment short. Postclypeus small, flat, not demarcated from the frons; anteclypeus narrow, whitish. Mandibles somewhat sabre-shaped, pointed apically; outer margin strongly incurved in the basal half, abruptly and somewhat angularly incurved in the apical half. Left mandible with 2 marginal teeth, the inner margin between the apical tooth and the first marginal tooth lobed; first marginal tooth triangular and pointed; second marginal tooth also pointed, with a long posterior margin and a sharp notch where the molar plate begins; molar plate finely serrate. Right mandible with 1 marginal tooth, the region between the apical tooth and the first marginal tooth lobed; first marginal tooth triangular with a long posterior margin; molar plate short, serrate. Labrum ligulate, longer than wide, almost reaching the apex of the mandibles; apex transparent with a fringe of hairs, with several long hairs in addition on the front. Postmentum bottle-shaped, much longer than wide, widest in the anterior third; waist (minimum width) near the base; densely hairy. Pronotum sparsely hairy, much wider than long, somewhat trapezoidal; anterior margin convex with a median notch; anterolateral corners rounded; posterior margin nearly straight, very weakly concave in the middle. Mesonotum slightly narrower than the pronotum, sides rounded, posterior margin weakly concave or nearly straight. Metanotum as wide as the pronotum, posterior margin nearly straight. Legs slender, short, hairy; tarsi 4-segmented. Abdomen globular, hairy; cerci 2-segmented. Measurements (mm; 2 individuals, holotype in parentheses): total body length about 3.00—3.25 (3.25); head length (to the mandibular base) 0.95—0.98 (0.98); maximum head width 0.85—0.90 (0.85); head index (width/length) 0.814—0.894 (0.814); left mandible length 0.63 (0.63); right mandible length 0.60—0.63 (0.60); head-mandible length index (mandible length/head length) 0.642—0.663 (0.642); labrum length (including the transparent apex) 0.38—0.40 (0.40), width 0.25—0.28 (0.28); postmentum length 0.63—0.65 (0.65), maximum width 0.28, minimum width (waist) 0.18; pronotum length 0.28, maximum width 0.50—0.53 (0.53); mesonotum width 0.45; metanotum width 0.53.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head milky white; antennae, legs and thorax whitish; abdomen semitransparent, pinkish where the gut contents show through. Head and body fairly hairy. Total body length 2.80—3.59 mm. Head subsquare, wider than long (to the apex of the labrum 1.0—1.20 mm); head length (to the mandibular base) 0.80—0.90 mm, head width 1.0—1.13 mm; sides weakly rounded, posterior margin rounded. Fontanelle indistinct. Compound eyes and ocelli absent. Postclypeus raised and hairy, much wider than long (width 0.40—0.50, length 0.10—0.13 mm); anteclypeus thin, transparent. Antenna 12—13 segments; with 12 segments, segment 3 long, club-shaped, longer than segment 2, with 13 segments, segment 3 the shortest; the remaining segments globose. Labrum dome-shaped, wider than long (width 0.37—0.43, length 0.20—0.25 mm). Mandibles square, of the Parrhinotermes type. Pronotum somewhat saddle-shaped, hairy (width 0.50—0.53, length 0.20—0.25 mm); anterior margin with a weak median notch; posterior margin weakly concave. Legs and abdomen as in the soldier.
